name: exercise_library
description: Full regeneration output for the admin-owned exercise library. One entry per Firestore document to write: entries with a non-null `id` overwrite that existing document in place (same doc ID); entries with `id: null` are brand-new documents. Designed for OpenAI structured outputs (response_format: json_schema, strict: true) - see exercise-regeneration.prompt.md for how to run it.

id.description: Existing Firestore document ID being regenerated, copied verbatim from the input list. Null only for a genuinely new exercise with no existing document.

name.description: Exercise name. For regenerated entries, keep the recognizable identity of the original (users have logged workouts against it) - fixing stray whitespace, casing, or obvious typos is fine, but don't turn it into a different movement.

targetMuscles.description: One or more muscles this exercise trains, primary first. Use every muscle actually loaded (e.g. a full-body Olympic lift lists several) - don't pad with tangential assistance muscles.

instructions.description: Ordered, numbered-in-spirit step-by-step cues, written as separate array elements (one instruction per element, not one long paragraph).
